latest.title: Finite speed of propagation and waiting time phenomena for stochastic porous media equations with nonlinear conservative noise
latest.abstract: Starting from localized energy estimates, we prove finite speed of propagation for kinetic solutions to stochastic porous media equations with nonlinear conservative noise, the existence and uniqueness of which has recently been established. In particular, we propose a novel iteration technique which allows us to obtain a Stampacchia-type inequality involving one single integral quantity, despite the possibly different scaling behaviors of the porous media and the noise term. This allows us to apply stochastic filtering arguments developed for the case of linear source-type noise. Using related ideas, we identify flatness conditions on initial data which guarantee locally the occurrence of a waiting time phenomenon, i.e., the onset of forward propagation of the solution's support is locally delayed. The condition for the latter matches the one for the deterministic porous media equation up to a logarithmic correction in the case of critical nonlinearity in the noise, but it requires more and more flatness of the initial data as the nonlinearity tends towards linear conservative noise. This is in line with the expected behavior: In the case of linear conservative noise, instantaneous forward motion is possible due to the effects of stochastic transport, no matter how flat the initial profile is.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究 stochastic porous medium equation 的 kinetic solutions，证明 finite speed of propagation 与 Wasserstein-type propagation。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 2.6 给出 FSOP 与 WTP，统一处理随机噪声下的支持传播。
latest.limitations: 依赖 kinetic solution 唯一性、噪声系数和定性初值条件；传播结论在文中 Wasserstein/kinetic 度量下表述。

steps.route: 用 kinetic formulation 的测试函数与截断，控制非线性扩散项和随机积分的可积性。

steps.claim: Lemma 4.2 建立 stopping time 下的 localized energy estimate。
steps.route: 对局部截断能量应用 Itô 公式，估计噪声二次变差并吸收扩散误差，得到统一局部界。

steps.claim: Theorem 2.6 由 kinetic 唯一性和局部估计闭合 FSOP/WTP。
steps.route: 将局部能量界沿 stopping times 拼接，利用 kinetic solutions 的唯一性识别极限，并把支持传播转译为 Wasserstein 距离估计。
